## Study approach
Why few-shot prompting has a flat scaling curve on GSM8K. CoT as adaptive test-time compute via an externalized scratchpad (Nye et al. 2021). Emergent at scale when intermediate states are materialized as tokens.

## Break-it experiments
1. **AGENT** — Harness that force-decodes a wrong intermediate step ("14 × 3 = 99") on GSM8K and measures whether the model self-corrects.
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_harness_that_force_decodes_a_wro.ipynb`
2. **HAND→AGENT** — Self-consistency, K=10 samples at T=0.7 with majority vote; expect +10–15% over greedy.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_self_consistency_k_10_samples_at.ipynb`
